🎯 🔥 Ultimate MVSD Murderer Vs Sheriff Duels Script 🔥 🎯
Get ready to dominate the arena in style with this feature-packed script designed for Murderer Vs Sheriff Duels (MVSD)! Whether you're hunting or hiding, this script gives you the unfair advantage you’ve been dreaming of. 💥

✨ Main Features:

🔫 HBE (Hitbox Expander) – Make every shot count with larger, more forgiving hitboxes. Precision? Overrated.
⚡ TP HBE (Teleport Hitbox Expand) – Blink straight to your target with pinpoint accuracy and strike in a flash. 💨
🏃‍♂️ Speed Boost – Zoom past your enemies like a blur with adjustable speed settings!
🦘 Jump Power – Leap over obstacles or surprise your foes from above – airborne attacks just got cooler!
🎯 Silent Aim – Your bullets know where to go – even when you miss. Stealthy and deadly. 💀
👁️‍🗨️ ESP (Extra Sensory Perception) – Wallhack-style visuals let you see enemies through walls. Nobody hides from you.
🎯 Tracers – Draw lines from your eyes to theirs – so you always know who you're targeting.
💡 Highlights – Light up players with team-based or role-based colors, making it easy to separate threats from teammates.

🧠 Built with smooth performance, user-friendly toggles, and a clean aesthetic to blend right into your game like magic. 🌟

💣 Whether you’re the Sheriff bringing justice or the Murderer causing chaos, this script ensures you’re always one step ahead. 💣

🛠️ Constantly updated 🔄 | ⚙️ Undetectable settings | 🧪 Optimized for FPS | 🧨 Easy to integrate
